# Life Gamified

> A fantasy-RPG quest journal for one real person. AI agents can read and write it on their behalf.

- Agent guide (start here): https://zsgacmfbqqmbcexomyoo.supabase.co/functions/v1/lg-agent/docs
- REST base URL: https://zsgacmfbqqmbcexomyoo.supabase.co/functions/v1/lg-agent
- MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP): https://zsgacmfbqqmbcexomyoo.supabase.co/functions/v1/lg-agent/mcp
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer lg_…` — the owner creates keys in the app under Settings → Agent access.
